title: Make the March report read one month

ticket.subject: The March report scans the whole year
body: `report.sql` gives the right March 2025 revenue per store, but it reads every file in `lake/sales/`.
The folders are already partitioned by year and month. Could you rewrite the filter so DuckDB only opens
Tip: `EXPLAIN ANALYZE <your query>` shows *Total Files Read* for each Parquet scan.

acceptance.text: report.sql returns the March 2025 revenue per store and DuckDB reads one file

checks.expected_query: SELECT store, round(sum(amount), 2) AS revenue FROM read_csv('data/sales.csv') WHERE sale_date >= DATE '2025-03-01' AND sale_date < DATE '2025-04-01' GROUP BY store

hints: A filter on `sale_date` is checked inside each file; a filter on the partition columns is checked on the folder names, before any file opens.
Filter on `year = 2025 AND month = 3` (the columns `hive_partitioning = true` adds).
Run `EXPLAIN ANALYZE` on your query in the same file to see Total Files Read go from 6 to 1.
